policy: Known debt may decrease but must not increase. New absolute compatibility or production guarantees fail closed.

items.safe_direction: Replace universal compatibility wording with VERIFIED_LIMITED plus device-matrix scope.
Replace crash guarantee with measured device/kernel/page-size receipts and explicit untested TOKEN_VAZIO combinations.
Require signed release, install/launch receipts and declared production gate before production wording.
Use distinct package/authority configuration language until collision-free installation is tested across the declared matrix.
